description: Golden cases for the terminal settler, shared by internal/settle (Go, conformance_test.go) and cf-controller/src/settle.ts (cf-controller/test/conformance.test.ts): what a program wrote to a terminal, and the lines a reader would see, byte for byte. A Text is a string, or an array of parts, each a string or {"repeat": string, "count": n}, joined. `input` is a Text; each entry of `want` is one line (a Text), or {"line": Text, "times": n} for n identical lines. Every input under 512 bytes is also fed split at every byte offset, which must settle as the whole does.
